summary: Phase 23 stop-the-line record (23-SPEC: work stops and goes to the operator at once for a bug not already in the register). While building the real-path harness, the 23-01 Task 1 executor saw the first anti-rug start on a chain with a fresh database raise a GAP DETECTED alert for the whole chain history: the dry-run stamp (src/anti-rug/detector.ts:588 at HEAD, :585 at the audit base) inserts the chain_state row with last_seen_block 0 (src/utils/db.ts:509-514 at HEAD) before backfillSinceLastSeen reads it, so the backfill's no-row seed branch never runs, the gap from block 0 exceeds maxBackfillBlocks, and the gap branch logs an error, sends the Telegram alert "[GAP DETECTED] eth missed 21000000 blocks" and broadcasts antirug_event kind gap-detected before moving the cursor to the head. Observed on the fake chain (op trail antirug.register > antirug.listener.subscribed > antirug.backfill.gap-detected) and confirmed by the execute-phase orchestrator re-reading the code. No capital action is taken in that branch. Not covered by AUD-ANTIRUG-005 (backfill contract) or AUD-ANTIRUG-009 (meaning of the dry-run stamp). The tier is immediate because the Phase 23 rule stops the line at once for any new bug; the item itself is S3 and needs no escalation under the Phase 22 tier rules.
